mission.foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

source_capture.reason: Official CFTC report page was retrieved for research but was not captured through Barrot's RawReceiptArchive.

limitations: Futures-only legacy report, not futures-and-options combined.
Positions are as of Tuesday November 3, not the retrieval date.
CFTC categories do not identify individual traders or position intent.
Tentative schedule; federal holidays can delay releases.
Trader categories reflect CFTC classifications; no trader identity or position intent is disclosed.
Announcement describes a plan for twice-weekly publication by the end of 2026; effective date remains unconfirmed.

cftc_positioning.report_type: Legacy Commitments of Traders, Futures Only, Long Format

derived.interpretation: Non-commercial net long increased by 185 contracts even though both long and short positions fell; short positions fell by 466 while longs fell by 281. This is consistent with greater short covering than long liquidation, not necessarily new long accumulation.

caveats: COT is a weekly, lagged snapshot of regulated CME futures, not spot holdings, exchange flows, or all offshore perpetual contracts.
XRP-equivalent contract notionals are contract-count conversions, not actual XRP custody or cash capital.
Non-commercial does not identify a particular fund, beneficial owner, or directional intent.
The report's concentration ratios indicate a small, concentrated market; the total open interest is much smaller than aggregate offshore perpetual OI.

release_schedule.reason: CFTC's 2026 release schedule marks November 16 as a delayed release due to a federal holiday; November 13 is not listed.
release_schedule.semiweekly_plan: CFTC announced October 27 that it plans to publish Monday positions on Wednesday and Wednesday positions on Friday by the end of 2026, both at 15:30 ET.

observations.claim: As of November 3, CME XRP futures open interest was 7,216 contracts (360.8M XRP contract-equivalent). Non-commercial traders were net long 1,465 contracts (73.25M XRP equivalent), up 185 contracts from October 27 while total OI fell 845 contracts. Four or fewer traders held 81.0% of gross long and 67.4% of gross short positions; eight or fewer held 95.1% and 87.7%, respectively.
observations.quality_status: primary_CFTC_weekly_report; lagged; web-rendered; no raw receipt

competing_hypotheses.claim: The increase in non-commercial net long came more from short covering than from fresh long accumulation.
support: Non-commercial longs fell 281 contracts while shorts fell 466.
disconfirming_or_missing: COT does not identify traders or intent.
No synchronized spot/perpetual data was captured in the same raw archive.
tests: Compare weekly COT changes with spot returns, CME volume, offshore OI and funding using publication-time-safe lags.
Test whether net-position changes add out-of-sample lift beyond momentum and volatility baselines.

competing_hypotheses.claim: CME XRP futures positioning is concentrated and may not represent the broader XRP derivatives market.
support: Four or fewer traders held 81.0% of gross long positions.
CME OI is 360.8M XRP-equivalent, distinct from multi-venue offshore perpetual OI.
disconfirming_or_missing: The report covers regulated CME futures and may still reflect institutional hedging not visible in offshore venues.
Trader concentration does not reveal common beneficial ownership or position intent.
tests: Compare CFTC COT with CME contract volume/OI and offshore venue OI by timestamp.
Keep futures-only and futures-and-options combined series separate.

predictions.reason: CFTC positions are lagged, not captured by Barrot RawReceiptArchive, and not synchronized with current spot/perpetual data.

integration_gap.legacy_futures_only_cot_adapter: not present in xrp_public_ingestion.py source registry at capture time
integration_gap.distinction: Legacy COT uses commercial/non-commercial categories; TFF uses dealer/intermediary, asset manager/institutional, leveraged funds and other reportables. Do not merge the taxonomies.
integration_gap.recommended_next_action: Add a dedicated weekly cftc_legacy_cme_futures_only source/adapter, preserve report date and publication timestamp separately, capture raw bytes and receipt, and test holiday delays including 2026-11-16. Keep the announced semiweekly schedule disabled until CFTC confirms its effective date.
